title: Go: Markdown Parser
description: Build a Markdown to HTML parser using line-by-line parsing and a state machine.

steps.title: Inline tokens: bold, italic, code
steps.description: Implement `ParseInline(text string) string` that converts `**bold**`, `*italic*`, and `` `code` `` to `<strong>`, `<em>`, and `<code>` tags. Print the HTML output of `"This is **bold** and *italic*"` using `fmt.Println(ParseInline(input))`.
hints: Use `strings.Replace` or `regexp` for each token type.
Order matters: process `` ` `` first to avoid conflicts, then `**`, then `*`.
Use `regexp.MustCompile(\"\\*\\*([^*]+)\\\\*\\*\")` for bold.

verification.successMessage: Inline bold, italic, and code are rendered.

steps.title: Block parser: headings and paragraphs
steps.description: Implement `ParseBlock(line string) (string, bool)` that detects ATX headings (`# ` to `###### `) and paragraphs. Headings become `<h1>` through `<h6>`. Print the HTML for `"# Title"` and `"A paragraph."` separated by newlines.
hints: Count `#` prefix to determine heading level.

Non-heading lines wrapped in `

` tags.
Return the HTML string and a boolean indicating if the line was consumed.

verification.successMessage: Headings and paragraphs render to HTML.

steps.title: Code blocks (fenced)
steps.description: Detect fenced code blocks starting with ` ``` ` (triple backticks). Collect all lines until the closing fence and wrap in `<pre><code>`. Print the HTML of a small Go code snippet fenced with triple backticks.
hints: Use a state variable `inCodeBlock bool` to track fenced blocks.
When a line starts with ` ``` `, toggle `inCodeBlock`.
Inside code blocks, pass lines through without inline parsing.

steps.title: Nested lists
steps.description: Parse unordered (`-`, `*`) and ordered (`1.`) lists. Support nesting by tracking indentation levels. Render `<ul>`/`<ol>` and `<li>` elements. Print the HTML for a nested list: `- item 1\n  - sub item\n- item 2`.
hints: Track `indent` level (number of leading spaces / 2).
When indent increases, open a new `<ul>`; when it decreases, close tags.
Use a stack to manage open list tags.

verification.successMessage: Nested lists render with proper HTML nesting.
verification.failureMessage: Check indent tracking for correct <ul>/<li> structure.

steps.title: Link and image parsing
steps.description: Parse `[text](url)` as `text` and `![alt](url)` as ``. Print the HTML of `"Click [here](https://example.com)"` and `"![logo](logo.png)"`.
hints: Render links before other inline tokens, images before links.

verification.failureMessage: Links become text, images become .

steps.title: HTML renderer
steps.description: Build an end-to-end `RenderMD(md string) string` that processes all block and inline elements, producing a complete HTML document. Print the full HTML output of a markdown document with headings, paragraphs, code, and a list.
hints: Split input into lines, process each through the block parser state machine.
Pass block content through inline parsing before emitting.
Wrap all output in `<!DOCTYPE html><html><body>...</body></html>`.

verification.successMessage: Full HTML document rendered from markdown.
verification.failureMessage: RenderMD should produce a complete HTML document.

steps.title: Table support
steps.description:
Parse GitHub-flavored markdown tables: `| col1 | col2 |` with `|---|---|` separator. Render `
col1col2
`. Print the HTML of a simple table with a header and one data row.
hints: Detect table rows by leading `|`.
Parse separator row (`|---|---|`) to determine header vs data rows.
Split cells by `|` and trim whitespace.
